summary.tldr: Requires the environment minister to promote transparency and accountability for certain Canadian commitments under the Convention on Biological Diversity.
what_it_does: Requires the Minister of the Environment to promote transparency and accountability in relation to certain commitments Canada has made under the Convention on Biological Diversity.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 13 June 2024 and received first reading. It is called the Nature Accountability Act.
